items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: with Rene I Rene the guitar player and I we was on that boat I mean we was together and we went back to New Orleans

ctx.x: Yes. Although it was pretty rough I had a pretty tough time with the special arrangements because this was my first time playing special arrangements and they had a guy by the name of Rene there was another Rene Hall and this Rene Hall is a ghetto player and he was a very very good musician and he was arranging music from the Duke Ellington era and during that time there was Black and Tain Fantasy was one of these things
so it was getting a little more elaborate
